notes.title: Release date, new demo and more!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913466/d398012503d644cc1b585ac9858810a0de5efdb0.jpg
Plenty of good news ahead! First of all I want to officially announce The Fall of Elena Temple is releasing on June 18th. Make sure to wishlist the game to be notified when it goes live!

Another highlight is the newly updated demo, which now includes the first eight rooms in the game for free. Give it a try as soon as possible, as the progress will transfer to the full game - you'll even unlock the corresponding achievements once you open the full version.

As you can see in the image above, The Fall of Elena Temple already has some great press reviews. You can check out all the coverage the game has gotten so far here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913466/93954639cc5058f52db7ca3f8990ef5ba5478918.jpg
And to top it all off, The Fall of Elena Temple has won the Jury's Pick award at Dev.Play 2024, for which I'm honored and grateful!

Make sure to wishlist the game, play the updated demo, watch the dev stream during this Steam Next Fest and play the game when it releases on June 18th! You're awesome!
